pinna.name: Pinna / Auricle
pinna.description: Cartilaginous flap of the outer ear that collects airborne sound pressure waves and directs them into the external auditory canal.

auditory_canal.name: External Auditory Canal (Meatus)
auditory_canal.description: Tube leading from pinna to tympanic membrane; secretes cerumen (wax) to trap dust and foreign particles and lubricate the canal.

tympanic_membrane.name: Tympanic Membrane (Eardrum)
tympanic_membrane.description: Taut, thin fibrous membrane separating the outer and middle ear that vibrates in mechanical resonance with incoming sound waves.

eustachian_tube.name: Eustachian Tube
eustachian_tube.description: Air-filled duct connecting middle ear cavity to nasopharynx, equalizing atmospheric pressure on both sides of the tympanic membrane.

malleus.name: Malleus (Hammer)
malleus.description: First auditory ossicle attached to tympanic membrane; transmits sound vibrations directly onto the body of the incus.

incus.name: Incus (Anvil)
incus.description: Intermediate ossicle acting as a mechanical lever linking vibrations from malleus to stapes with amplified mechanical force.

stapes.name: Stapes (Stirrup)
stapes.description: Smallest ossicle whose footplate vibrates against the membrane of the oval window, converting air vibrations into fluid pressure waves.

auditory_ossicles.name: Auditory Ossicles (Malleus, Incus, Stapes)
auditory_ossicles.description: Three miniature middle ear bones (malleus, incus, stapes) that mechanically amplify vibrations from tympanic membrane to oval window.

semicircular_canals.name: Semicircular Canals (Dynamic Balance)
semicircular_canals.description: Three fluid-filled orthogonal bony loops containing cristae in swollen ampullae that detect rotational and angular head acceleration.

cochlea.name: Cochlea (Organ of Corti)
cochlea.description: Spiral snail-shell bony chamber containing perilymph, endolymph, and sensory hair cells of the Organ of Corti that transduce vibrations to nerve impulses.

auditory_nerve.name: Auditory Nerve (Vestibulocochlear Nerve)
auditory_nerve.description: Transmits acoustic sensory information from organ of Corti and equilibrium information from semicircular canals to temporal lobe of cerebral cortex.
